access: Free. A street tree on a public sidewalk, viewable from the pavement at any hour.
transport: No Metro within about 1.5 km. Nearest is Foggy Bottom-GWU (about 2 km); Georgetown and Wisconsin Avenue buses are the usual approach.
verify_notes: Remarkable: the DC inventory tags this tree "City Tree champion of its genus", i.e. the arborist rates it the best linden in the city's care (the record gives no contest or measurement list behind the wording); DBH 55.4 in (about 141 cm; girth about 442 cm computed from DBH). LiDAR crown fields in the same record: crown height about 73 ft, crown area about 4,050 sq ft. Alive: arborist condition entry "Excellent" dated 2026-10-07. Pin: the inventory GPS point for FACILITYID 18456-380-3005-0216-000 (tree box); the nearest neighbours within 20 m are a silver maple of 35 in and small trees, so this is the dominant crown at the address. ONE SOURCE (the owner of the tree, DDOT UFD); the "champion" wording is the arborist note, not a published contest. Age: not documented; no planting date in the record. Species per inventory (Tilia americana). Access: public sidewalk. Photo: none found (Commons geosearch 60 m: no file). Recognition line (from the record only): The street linden at 3819 T St NW, tagged in the city inventory as the champion of its genus.

verify_notes: DBH 57.2 in (about 145 cm; girth about 456 cm computed from DBH), by a wide margin the largest Osage orange in the DC inventory: the other Osage oranges within 20 m measure 19.6 to 38.1 in. Crown area about 950 sq ft, crown height about 63 ft. Alive: "Fair" 2026-08-19. Pin: inventory GPS point for FACILITYID 10340-155-3001-0095-000, among a group of Osage oranges in the park, so a visitor needs the largest of the group. ONE SOURCE (DDOT UFD). Age not documented. Flag: the record carries no stem count; the group of Osage oranges at Volta Park is itself notable. Recognition line (from the record only): The largest of the Osage oranges in Volta Park, a mature Osage orange with a trunk much heavier than those beside it.
